title: A7 R2 mechanical layout inputs (project choices only)
datum: Same as engineering/a7/study/parameters.json: X across the panel (0 = left panel edge), Y down the panel (0 = top edge), Z into the rack with the PMMA rear surface at Z=0. The controller PCB lies in a Y-Z plane; jack bodies and SMD parts sit on its +X (component) face; THT terminals pass to its -X (solder) face.
authority: Jack, nut, panel, PCB-thickness, trim and tolerance inputs come only from engineering/a7/study/parameters.json (R1). Switch dimensions come only from engineering/a7/evidence/component-a7-pcm13smtr/facts.json (R1). A5 optical, adapter, leaf, rail and cable facts come from engineering/a5 (read-only). This file holds R2's own choices; every value carries a confidence label from parameters.json.
status: Provisional digital study. Not a fit approval, not a part approval, not a manufacturing release.

offset_sweep.note: R1 evaluated offsets 0 / 0.3 / 0.6 / 0.9; R2 sweeps the same R1 calculation at finer steps

candidate_selection.rule_2hp: Among 2HP offsets x PCB thicknesses with trimmed leads, keep only rows whose nominal margins are all >= 0 and whose nominal nut edge margin meets the R1 preferred 0.3 mm; pick the row with the largest worst-corner minimum hard margin, then the largest nominal minimum margin, then the thicker PCB.
candidate_selection.rule_3hp: 3HP centred with the thickest PCB option that is FEASIBLE ON PAPER with untrimmed leads (no factory trim dependency).

axial_option.reason: Only R1 axial option that meets the 1.0 mm worst-corner engagement criterion; the rectangular pocket also keys the jack body against nut torque so the solder joints are not the anti-rotation path. Depends on R1 Q8 (pocket depth tolerance, appearance, strength) and Q9 (clamp load).

nut.note: Dimension reference only (R1); fit on the SOFNG barrel is UNVERIFIED (R1 Q4).

pitch.source: A5 jack_y pitch 14.0 is the floor; the pitch grows until each label fits between the jack bodies and pockets without overlapping them

jacks.near_edge_note: the 5.4 mm axis-to-edge side (pin 2 side) faces down, toward the setting switch; both jacks share one orientation so one footprint serves both

label_cap_height.source: A5 front_panel labels IN/OUT cap height 1.8

label_gap_to_body.note: clear label strokes must not sit in front of a jack body or rear pocket: the body is opaque and the pocket floor is not part of the frosted field

y_top.source: A5 mechanical controller.y[0]; clears the A5 adapter PicoBlade mated envelope (Y <= 47.85)

terminal_to_rear_edge.note: pad radius plus copper-to-edge allowance behind the rearmost jack terminal; the PJ-324M hole size is not sourced (R1 Q3)

controller.solder_side_rule: Solder (-X) face carries THT terminals and fillets only; no SMD parts, because the 2HP lead-side margin is the binding dimension

power_header.note: between the spine slot and the upper jack body; wires leave the mated plug along +X

led_header.note: row along Z near the rear edge; the cable leaves along +Y and folds back once in the gap in front of the optical volume, so the 50 mm finished length is used without a free loop

setting_switch.part: C&K PCM13SMTR (R1 selection; JLC stock 0, R1 Q10)
setting_switch.placement: controller component face, bottom PCB edge, actuator projecting toward +Y and sliding along Z
setting_switch.access: Setup control: reached from below (+Y) with the module out of the rack; no front-panel access
setting_switch.label: ON / PGM / CV on the controller silkscreen next to the actuator (R4); position-to-mode order follows the R1 pin table, not the physical direction

front_screw_y.source: A5 front_panel carrier.front_screws_y (front M2 holes kept; the A5 Y65 controller hole is dropped)

m2.source: A5 front_panel front_washers.m2 and A5 mechanical hardware envelopes

adapter_post_radius.source: A5 build_mechanical front cradle post r2.5 at Y20.5

bottom_fork_y.note: integral tongue of the bottom optical cap straddling the controller rear edge; locates the optical stack, carries no jack load

supports.printed_material: PETG (A5 nominal); not sliced, not printed

power_finished_free_span.source: A5 mechanical README: Molex 151340300 50 +/- 6 mm between wire-exit shoulders

wire_radius.source: A5 mechanical cable model 0.8 mm design reserve

cables.status: Route scenarios only; manufacturer bend radius, insulation diameter and label storage are not qualified (#8).

sh_bundle_radius.note: four 0.8 mm design-reserve wires (A5) treated as one round bundle; real insulation diameter not sourced

power_bundle_radius.note: three 0.8 mm design-reserve wires as one round bundle

preferred_bend_radius.note: design target only; no manufacturer bend radius is retained

led_route.note: descent just below the A5 adapter PCB (Y<=48) and above leaf LED D2 (Y>=50.08); run between the controller rear edge and the leaf front

power_route.note: drop in front of the adapter, lane above the controller component reserve, one S-fold (layers Z 5/9/13, above the spine block Z<=4); the fold span is solved for the finished length

optical.note: Leaves, bond line, caps, L-section diffusers and M1.6 hardware follow A5 geometry; PET FPC leaves are not modelled (R1 pet-fpc.md, Q11); the FR-4 leaf is the reference/fallback.
